least_sure_answers.item: Zero-margin rows that hold only as designed contacts
least_sure_answers.answer: Confirmed at nominal: boss ends 0.0001 to the scanned flat, no overlap; reliefs 0.5000 (E-01); J-05 3.049; OD-C15 keep-outs and OD-C10 skirt touch at 0. Pass by construction, no margin.

least_sure_answers.item: The clearance > 0 fallback passes OD-G10 to housing on 3.6e-15
least_sure_answers.answer: Confirmed 3.55e-15, not inside; ShapeFix leaves OD-G10 unsound so no volume reading (F4); the panel's own fallback pairs read >= 11.689 and contact + 0.001.

Only the zero-gap rows fail at +-0.1: boss end, top edge, wall z against the OD-C15 keep-outs, each LOW (screws close a 0.1 gap; lid lifts or drops 0.1; 0.24 mm3 at undesigned feet). REQ-05 0.435, J-05 3.025 and D-04a 3.300 keep their gates.
